name: TOPY.AI AI CTO skills
description: AI CTO skills for founders, built for TOPY.AI: a chief technology officer that keeps what is live working and every release backed by evidence — CI failures explained from their logs, flaky tests quarantined, pull requests reviewed for risk, release notes, a release gate, safe deploys and rollbacks, incident response, dependency alerts and secrets hygiene, through the TOPY AI GitHub App on the TOPY CTO MCP server (https://topy.ai/mcp/cto); standalone skills are engineering methods that work anywhere.

tiers.core: Runs on the TOPY MCP server; needs a TOPY account.
tiers.connected: Uses TOPY data and actions when the MCP server is connected; works on its own otherwise.
tiers.standalone: An engineering method that works with any agent; can use TOPY where it fits.

skills.name: CI watch
skills.summary: How the AI CTO watches CI around the clock: a GitHub webhook per run, an email only on a failure or a recovery, with the failing jobs and the log lines.

skills.name: Connect the AI CTO
skills.summary: Connect the TOPY CTO MCP server and check what it can see: the GitHub App and its repositories, CI, alerts and service health.

skills.name: The CTO's goals
skills.summary: The AI CTO's standing goals and its status report for the CEO: uptime, deploy frequency and change failure rate, each with source and date or 'no data'.

skills.name: Morning engineering check
skills.summary: Each morning: service health, CI on the default branches, pull requests waiting and anything red — the one thing to fix first.

skills.name: Why did CI fail?
skills.summary: Explain a failed GitHub Actions run from its jobs and logs: the step, the cause in the log's own words, flaky or real, and the fix — then re-run or open an issue.

skills.name: CI hygiene
skills.summary: Keep CI fast and trustworthy: required checks, caching, a time budget, pinned actions, least-privilege tokens and no secrets in logs.

skills.name: Flaky tests
skills.summary: Tell a flaky test from a real failure, quarantine it with an owner and a deadline, and fix the cause (time, order, network, shared state) instead of re-running forever.

skills.name: Engineering issue triage
skills.summary: Turn bug reports and CI findings into issues worth fixing: reproduce, size, label, owner — and close what isn't actionable.

skills.name: Review a pull request
skills.summary: Review a pull request for what matters before merge: what changed, whether checks pass, and the risks — migrations, auth, money, secrets, irreversible steps, missing tests.

skills.name: Deploy safely
skills.summary: Ship to production in small steps: plan, the Founder's approval, deploy the gated build, canary, check live matches what was built, then report — or roll back.

skills.name: Release gate
skills.summary: Decide whether a build may ship: CI green on the exact commit, checks and QA passed, migrations reversible, rollback ready, and someone watching — evidence for each.

skills.name: Release notes
skills.summary: Draft release notes from the commits since the last release, grouped as new, improved and fixed in words customers understand — nothing is published.

skills.name: Roll back
skills.summary: When a release hurts, restore service first: redeploy the last good build, keep data safe, confirm recovery, then find the cause.

skills.name: Dependency and security alerts
skills.summary: Read Dependabot, code-scanning and secret-scanning alerts, fix what is exploitable first, and say plainly which alert kinds GitHub isn't showing and why.

skills.name: Secrets hygiene
skills.summary: Keep keys and tokens out of code, logs and chats: where secrets live, least privilege, rotation, and what to do in the first hour after one leaks.

skills.name: Architecture decision record
skills.summary: Record a technical decision so it can be revisited: the context, the options with their costs, the choice, its consequences, and what would make us change it.

skills.name: Incident response
skills.summary: When something customers use is down or wrong: one lead, stop the harm, restore service, communicate on a clock, then a blameless review with fixes.
